- The PRA requires that a report on the effectiveness of the model‑risk‑management (MRM) framework for financial reporting be provided to the audit committee on a regular basis and **at least annually** [1].  
- The report must be supplied **in a timely manner** so that the external auditor can use it when planning the statutory audit, enabling the auditor to assess and respond to the risk of material misstatement arising from model risk [1][3].
